Notes: Archivo Black is one weight only. Set headings in uppercase with -0.02em tracking and let the body do the rest.
Fraunces has an optical size axis. Set opsz to 96 on the h1 and 24 on smaller headings so it stays readable.
Bebas is uppercase by nature. Never use it below 20px and never for a paragraph.
Anton is loud by default, so keep the line count low. Two-line headings maximum.
Cormorant is thin at small sizes. Never set it under 28px and never in Muted grey.
Serif on serif works here because the sizes are far apart. Keep the menu itself in Lora at 17px minimum.

CSS Variables: --font-display: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; --font-body: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
Notes: Conservative on purpose. Numbers in pricing tables get IBM Plex Sans with tabular figures.
Bitter is a slab, so it holds up over a photo. Put a solid Ink scrim behind it, never a blur.
Newsreader italic is the strongest thing in this pairing. Use it once, on the pull quote.

CSS Variables: --font-display: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; --font-body: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
Notes: Instrument Serif has one weight. Get contrast from size, not from bold.
The most neutral pairing in the set, which is the point for an emergency trade. The phone number gets Rubik 600 at 20px in the header.
Bricolage has an optical size axis. Set opsz to 96 on the h1 or it looks like a default sans.

CSS Variables: --font-display: 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif; --font-body: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif;
Notes: Libre Baskerville runs large for its point size. Set the h1 smaller than you think and give the body 1.125rem, because people are here to read.
Atkinson was drawn for low vision readers, so it holds up in long logs and small labels. Dates get Chivo 600.

CSS Variables: --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-body: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif;
Notes: Fast to read at a glance, which is what a paid click needs. Keep the h1 under 12 words.
Syne at 800 is the whole personality. Use it on the hero and the price, nowhere else.

CSS Variables: --font-display: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-body: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; --font-serif: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif;
Heading Scale: h1 clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 4.5rem)/1.04 at 800 with -0.03em tracking, h2 clamp(1.9rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem)/1.08 at 700, h3 1.25rem/1.3
Notes: Inter is allowed here and only here, because the pairing is defined by the second face: three or four words of the headline set in Instrument Serif italic, in the accent colour, kept on one line with white-space nowrap. Sentence case headings, never uppercase. Without the serif emphasis this is the banned default, so the emphasis is not optional.
